'''Tava Yagen''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Bovo Yagen system/Legends|Bovo Yagen system]]. Several of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] had deposits of [[Durelium/Legends|Durelium]], [[Quadrillium/Legends|Quadrillium]] and [[Hfredium]] along with prismatic [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that were sent to [[Trellar Yagen (planet)|Trellar Yagen]] for processing.
